payload.claim: This docstring says `plan.json` is the raw block verbatim, but the change in this diff makes `plan.json` hold the block passed through `credentials.redact` before it is written (saffron/cell/session.py:2776-2777). The docstring now contradicts the code it documents: plan.json is no longer verbatim once any credential shape or the cell's own token is present. The task's own instructions explicitly called out this exact line for rewording and it was left unchanged.
